name: ZBar Cookies ‘N Cream
clue: A skateboarder on the wrapper might help you find this fiber-packed treat.
betterClue: Look for a USDA Organic snack bar inspired by cookies and cream, found among grab-and-go nutrition bars rather than candy bars.

name: Poppi Orange
clue: This modern take on a classic soft drink contains only 5 grams of sugar and shares its name with a burst of citrus color.
betterClue: Find the orange-flavored prebiotic soda in the bright orange can featuring a large citrus slice on the front.

name: Del Monte SLeaf Spinach
clue: Sailors once believed this leafy green could help prevent a nutritional deficiency. Today, you’ll find it preserved in a metal container rather than the produce section.
betterClue: Look for a canned vegetable known for its dark green leaves and association with a famous cartoon sailor.
